definition_zh: 反对人才碎片化，把「通识底座 + 专业深度 + 品格养成」作为不可分割的整体来设计课程、评价与治理，培养「公忠坚毅、能担当大任」的完整的人，而非单功能专家。
definition_en: Against talent fragmentation, design curriculum, assessment and governance as an indivisible whole of 'liberal base + professional depth + character cultivation', to raise whole persons who are 'public-spirited, steadfast, able to bear great responsibility' rather than single-function experts.

formulas: Talent = L ⊕ P ⊕ C   [人才 = 通识 ⊕ 专业 ⊕ 品格，三者不可约简]
Curriculum: w_L·L + w_P·P + w_C·C , w_L≈0.3   [三模块加权，通识占约 30%]
Governance: dept-autonomy ⊕ open-admin ⊕ student-autonomy   [三治融合]

variables.L: 通识底座（文史哲/科学方法）

formula_repr.prototype: Totalistic thinking / 总体性思维（大学育人系统总体设计版）

triggers: 培养目标是「完整的人/领袖」而非熟练工种
专业过早细分导致视野窄、迁移弱
组织需以价值观（非仅技能）凝聚与筛选
评价单一（唯分数/唯论文）催生功利与短视
anti_patterns: 把通识当「水课」、专业当唯一，割裂三者
一年级即分系，基础未牢便定向
评价唯终结考试，过程与品格不可见
治理集权，院系/学生无自治空间

steps_zh: 通识底座：一年级不分系，设文史哲/科学方法通识必修（约占 30%），先广后专。
专业深度：在通识之上建专业核心 + 实践实习，第一等教授亲授新生。
品格养成：以校训（求是）落三级执行标准——实事求是→求真务实→求全责备。
三模课程：通识+专业+实践三模块配套，拒绝「只造工程师」的窄目标。
三治治理：院系自治 + 校务公开 + 学生自治，以价值观而非行政命令凝聚。
两问牵引：以「到浙大来做什么 / 毕业后做什么样的人」持续唤醒使命，输出可担大任者。
steps_en: Liberal base: no department in year one; liberal (history/philosophy/science method) required (~30%), broad before deep.
Professional depth: on the liberal base, build professional core + practice; first-rate professors teach freshmen.
Character cultivation: school motto (Seek Truth) as a three-tier standard—truthfulness → realism → exhaustive rigor.
Three-module curriculum: liberal + professional + practice matched; reject the narrow 'just train engineers' goal.
Three-governance: department autonomy + open administration + student autonomy, cohesion by values not decree.
Two-questions pull: 'why Zhejiang U / what kind of person after' continually awaken mission, outputting responsible leaders.
historical_case_zh: 竺可桢 1936 任浙大校长即提「一年级不分系」；课程设通识必修（文史哲约 30%）+专业核心+实践实习三模块，评价用过程性 40%+终结性 60%，治理行院系自治+校务公开+学生自治三治。以王阳明「君子之学，岂有心于同异，唯求其是」定「求是」校训（1938-11-19 宜山校务会议），落为「不盲从不附和、只问是非不计利害」的品格标准。其「两问」与育人体系走出李政道、程开甲、谷超豪、叶笃正等，战时湄潭 7 年论文数超当时所有中国大学。
historical_case_en: On becoming Zhejiang U president (1936), Zhu set 'no department in year one'; curriculum = liberal required (~30%) + professional core + practice; assessment = 40% process + 60% terminal; governance = department autonomy + open admin + student autonomy. From Wang Yangming's 'seek only what is true' he fixed 'Seek Truth' as motto (1938-11-19 Yishan meeting), as the character standard 'no blind conformity, only right vs wrong, not self-interest'. His 'two questions' and system produced Li Zhengdao, Cheng Kaijia, Gu Chaohao, Ye Duzheng; in wartime Meitan (7 yrs) ZU papers exceeded all other Chinese universities.
modern_case_zh: 通识学院/书院制（如清华新雅、复旦任重）、企业「价值观+专业+轮岗」管培生体系、医学院「人文+临床+科研」三位一体——皆同此模式；反对「唯论文/唯 KPI」碎片化评价亦其反题。
modern_case_en: Liberal-arts colleges (e.g. Tsinghua Xinya), corporate 'values + specialty + rotation' trainee tracks, medical 'humanities + clinic + research' trinity—all the same pattern; opposing 'paper-only / KPI-only' fragmented assessment is its antithesis.
inheritance_note: B 级结构同构：对应总体性思维（模式 22）在社会总体/反碎片化的一般用法。A 级直链：竺可桢是 Protreptic 中将模式 22 用于「大学育人系统总体设计」、并把通识/专业/品格三维度不可割裂落为可考核三模块三治的第一人，补强模式 22 高频核心。
reason_zh: 竺可桢将模式 22（总体性思维）用于大学育人系统的整体设计：通识、专业、品格三维不可割裂，并以可考核的三模块课程与三治治理落地，是教育组织的总体性。
reason_en: Zhu maps mode 22 (totalistic thinking) onto holistic university-system design: liberal, professional and character dimensions are indivisible, landed as assessable three-module curriculum and three-way governance—totalism for educational organization.
expected_zh: 产出视野广、专业深、品格稳的完整人才，而非单功能工种；组织以价值观凝聚，评价覆盖过程与品格，可跨危机持续输出领袖。
expected_en: Produce broadly literate, deeply skilled, character-steady whole persons rather than single-function workers; the organization coheres by values, assessment covers process and character, and sustains leader output across crises.
digital_adaptation: Maps to competency-model design and holistic talent-OS in L&D systems.
author: serrano
cross_cultural_impact: Applicable to global earth-system science, observation-network design, long-horizon climate reconstruction, and resilience of academic institutions under crisis
education_tradition: Modern science / 现代科学教育（求是书院—浙大传统）
source_lineage: 《中国近五千年来气候变迁的初步研究》(考古学报 1972(1))
